title: Quantum Algorithms & Post-Quantum Cryptography
description: Master Shor's Algorithm, Grover's quadratic speedup, quantum threat to RSA, and NIST PQC lattice standards.

questions.question: Which famous quantum algorithm provides an exponential speedup for integer factorization, impacting modern RSA encryption?
What speedup does Grover's algorithm provide for unstructured database search?
options: Exponential speedup equal to Shor's algorithm

questions.question: Which mathematical family forms the primary basis for NIST-standardized Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms like ML-KEM (Kyber)?
What is the 'Harvest Now, Decrypt Later' (HNDL) cyber threat?
options: Adversaries collecting encrypted traffic today to decrypt once cryptographically relevant quantum computers exist
Ransomware deleting hard drive partition tables
Malware harvesting user browser passwords via phishing
Stealing cooling liquid from quantum laboratories

questions.question: What is the primary challenge in scaling NISQ (Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum) devices to fault-tolerant computers?
options: Quantum error correction requiring hundreds to thousands of physical qubits per logical qubit
The lack of classical programming languages like Python
The complete unavailability of liquid helium worldwide
Quantum computers being limited to single-bit calculations
